description: NaSrZrNbO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.91 Å. Sr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. All Sr-O bond lengths are 2.91 Å. Zr is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Zr-O bond lengths are 2.10 Å. Nb is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Nb-O bond lengths are 2.01 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sr, one Zr, and one Nb atom.
